title: Techspert Raises £5M in Debt Financing from Palatine Growth Credit
summary: Cambridge-based AI-powered life sciences expert network Techspert secured £5 million in debt financing from Palatine Growth Credit to hire approximately 20 employees and expand its AI-driven research tools and expert matching platform.
whyItMatters: New funding for an AI-native expert network validates investor interest in technology-first approaches to expert matching.
